title: More photos: Girard, Wingy, Barbarin, Oliver, Armstrong, Chink Martin, first Rhythm Kings
summary: Mares names more pictures, including the first small Rhythm Kings band with Rappolo, Pettis and Schoebel, and Armstrong's Hot Five.

story.theme_name: Who was in the band: naming sidemen and personnel
story.community_name: Who played in the band: reciting personnel

blocks.x: And now let's see if we can go back over here.

Because naturally we've got little Georgie Girard here. He's passed on a few years back. I thought Georgie could have been one of the big names in our music if he'd have lived. But just one of the unfortunate things. But those things happen. Now, above Georgia, we've got old Wingy Minhoom. Everybody knows Wingy. And to the right, Paul Barberin. Everybody knows Paul. King Oliver and Louis Armstrong, drummer. On top, we've got Louis up here holding his trumpet. Of course, I've got Louis in two or three places around the place because, like my favorite, he's everybody else's. And I'm very fond of Louis. Have to be. And different spots here. We've got pictures of old Chink Martin. Old bass boy from, tuba boy from back in the Rhythm King's days. And we've got the late Abby Brunus under Chink Martin. He's drummer. Not the trumpet player, but the drummer. The nephew of Abby Brunus.
This other picture of rap up here. Do you remember where that was taken from? Is that from one of the Rhythm King's?
That's one of the Rhythm Kings and I had blown up, put on this wall right here. That was taken when the band was first organized, the first small band. When we had rap.
That's where he's playing. We could almost count the keys on the clarinet there.

That's right. And that's Jack Pettis in the background there. That's the original first band put together. When Alma Schober was on piano and Jack Pettis on sax and rapping, Paul and Georgie and Mel Stetzel also played a little with the band.
Well, that covers quite a few. I was going to ask, too. At home, you say you have a big collection, too, I imagine. Bill, I have a marvelous collection. I have thousands of them.

This is a fine picture over here that we missed. That's Louie and his Hot Five over there. Johnny St. C. and Johnny Dodds and Louie and Lil Hardin. And actually, over here, we have the Bobcats with Favre and Eddie Miller and with Duke and Nappy Lamar. A lot of New Orleans boys there.
